description: Refine a model's parameter classes by editing what the model SAYS (tags on a place or transition, or assertedClasses), then re-derive. Returns a NEW model id (ids are content addresses, so the original stays reachable) plus a before/after class diff. tags can only split classes; assertedClasses declares a merge and gets re-verified and costed, never trusted blind. Read the sim://docs/classification resource once for why the two levers are not symmetric. Costs 2 tokens from your account's compute bucket (the stored model, 1, and the verified re-classification, 1).

gate.description: monotone acceptance gate (default false): store the refinement only if the engine-computed defect weight strictly decreases; otherwise store nothing and return accepted:false with the before/after weights and the reason. Weight = dead transitions + unmarked siphons + unreachable goals + unverified asserted classes + lost conservation laws, all engine-computed (see sim://docs/classification). Weights and the regression-rate counters are reported whether or not the gate is on. A model already at weight 0 can never be improved, so a gated refine of one is always rejected.

goals.description: optional JSON array of declared reachability goals, e.g. [{"to":{"done":1}}] (each may carry "from"); a goal sim_reach answers "no" to adds 1 to the defect weight, "unknown" adds nothing.

signature.description: optional hex signature over the CID of the signed claim; see modelstore.SignedClaim for the exact bytes. An unverifiable signature is refused, not stored with a flag.

signer.description: optional {"type":"eth"|"ed25519","address":"..."} — signs the lineage claim so it is the refiner's word rather than the server's account of a session

tags.description: JSON object of place OR transition id -> {key: value}, e.g. {"nurse_avail":{"refine.shift":"night"}}. Keys not prefixed refine. are stored as metadata and refine nothing. classify.go's colour refinement seeds from both places' and transitions' tags, so either kind of id works here.

name: sim_refine
